A rickshaw puller plays an important role by carrying passengers from one place to another. An illiterate, unskilled and unemployed man of our country choses rickshaw pulling as his profession He earns money and thus he earns his livelihood. Sometimes, he carries goods in his rickshaw. He usually don't have a rickshaw of his own so, he hires a rickshaw from its owner on dally basls. He comes out on the road early in the morning and works with his rickshaw till the late hours of night. He pulls rickshaw in both sun and the rain. He demands more fare in foul weather. He can't take rest.

The work of a rickshaw puller is very risky In a busy city or atown, So, he may fall a victim to a road accident. He must pull rickshaw to earn the daily bread for himself and his Family. He can't provide food, education and medicine to his family properly. He usually lives in slum are or a cheap rental room in a remote area. He can't save money. he lives from hand to mouth. His demands are few, if he can man. two square meals for himself and his family, he be-comes happy. But, sometimes his income is less than his demands. Then, he Faces difficulties. If, he becomes sick, he and his family fall in trouble. He takes hi food from cheap roadside stalls. He leads a very sad and miserable life. We should be sympathetic and show due respect to the man's service. Our Govt. should give him small loan and offer him proper shelter and education to lead a better life.
